svg.text: What happens on every frame, and how a graph and a link are evaluated.
Clip time = (t − start) × speed, or t × speed when the start mode is Continuous.
After each commit, FBOs whose node or link no longer exists are released.
evaluate the graph at clip time (section 3)
image or video texture, fitted to 16:9
Effect chain in order, fx0 / fx1
onto the accumulator with the clip’s
Content clip: renders its own source, then its effects.
Effect clip: processes everything composited below its
track so far, like an adjustment layer.
A higher track affects more layers.
Audio media has no image: it drives values through
a Media node’s level output instead.
Loops are refused when a link is created, so the sort always succeeds.
Node FBOs use the graph’s resolution and are keyed n + node uid.
Converter = the one for the input’s type
(the source’s type when the input is “any”).
Settings = Parameters owned by the Link.
Texture → value: 8×8 GPU readback (average, brightness, samples).
To texture: fills, gradients, or pass-through at gain 1.
